"""Own camera-guided Panda controller; only rcb_client accesses the robot.
The middle artwork is ukiyo-e. Button localization uses RGB-D cameras.
"""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT=Path('/app/output')
def tf(p, rot):
    t=np.eye(4);t[:3,:3]=rot;t[:3,3]=p;return t

def fk(q):
    t=tf([0,-.4,.78],R.from_euler('z',np.pi/2).as_matrix())
    params=[([0,0,.333],0),([0,0,0],-np.pi/2),([0,-.316,0],np.pi/2),([.0825,0,0],np.pi/2),([-.0825,.384,0],-np.pi/2),([0,0,0],np.pi/2),([.088,0,0],np.pi/2)]
    for v,(p,a) in zip(q,params):
        t=t@tf(p,R.from_euler('x',a).as_matrix())@tf([0,0,0],R.from_euler('z',v).as_matrix())
    return t@tf([0,0,.2],R.from_euler('z',-np.pi/4).as_matrix())

def ik(p,q,limits):
    rot=np.array([[0,-1,0],[-1,0,0],[0,0,-1]])
    def cost(x):
        t=fk(x)
        return np.r_[5*(t[:3,3]-p),R.from_matrix(rot.T@t[:3,:3]).as_rotvec(),.015*(x-q)]
    sol=least_squares(cost,q,bounds=(limits[:,0]+.001,limits[:,1]-.001),max_nfev=300)
    if np.linalg.norm(fk(sol.x)[:3,3]-p)>.006:raise RuntimeError('Unreachable target')
    return sol.x

def move(r,p,name,duration=4):
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none')
    state=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now']);q=state[:7]
    limits=np.array(r.spec()['action_types']['joint_position']['panda_joint_limits_rad'])
    target=ik(np.array(p),q,limits)
    n=int(duration/.1)
    # Smooth interpolation limits initial velocity and acceleration.
    s=np.linspace(0,1,n);s=s*s*(3-2*s)
    actions=np.c_[q+(target-q)*s[:,None],np.zeros((n,2))]
    with open(OUT/'actions.jsonl','a') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({'name':name,'target_xyz':p,'actions':actions.tolist()})+'\n')
    res=r.submit('joint_position',actions,dt=.1,cameras=['forward','left','right'],video='none',include_depth=True,note=name)
    res.save(OUT/name)
    print(json.dumps(res.meta,indent=2))
    print('FK target',fk(target)[:3,3])
    return res

if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('name');parser.add_argument('xyz',nargs=3,type=float);parser.add_argument('--duration',type=float,default=4)
    args=parser.parse_args();r=Robot();move(r,args.xyz,args.name,args.duration)
